newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland offers public roll-over of index 1-yr bond.
newsitem.headline: Poland offers public roll-over of index 1-yr bond.

text.p: Poland will offer the public a chance to roll-over index-linked one-year bonds with this year's issue, due on December 3, 1997, at a price of 102.5 zlotys per bond, the treasury said in a statement.
It said the offer, below the issue price of 103 zlotys, was available from October 21 to holders of one-year bonds due on December 2, 1996.
The coupon for the 100-zloty one-year bond is the 12-month inflation beginning two months before the first day of public sale plus a three basis point interest margin.
Last year's one-year bond, due next month, will be worth 124.75 upon maturity, the treasury said.
This year's bonds will be available to the general public at the issue price from December 2, 1996, to February 28, 1997.
